hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Wall thickness checks on chokes, tees, and elbows carrying proppant returns.

name: Plug catcher
function: The strainer vessel that catches large pieces of milled plug, balls, and debris after the drillout so they do not reach the chokes.

tabs.overview: A basket or strainer inside a pressure body; flow passes through and large solids stay behind; emptied by isolating and opening the body. Usually first in line during the drillout returns.
tabs.engineering: Rated to wellhead pressure; basket mesh sized for plug debris.
tabs.connections: Between the wellhead iron and the sand separator.
tabs.safety: Isolated and bled before opening; debris can be sharp and hot.
tabs.evidence: Public flowback and well testing overview (S25), field practice (S9).
tabs.operations: Emptied per plug or on a differential pressure rise.
tabs.failure_modes: Basket plugging, body erosion, seal leaks.
